title: Choose the storage folder
summary: Pick the folder where Station keeps its data on first start, or see where it currently is.
alternateQueries: How do I set up Station the first time?
How do I change the storage folder?

steps.instruction: Start Djehuti Station for the first time.
steps.expectedResult: A message asks where the suite should keep its data.

steps.instruction: Choose Choose folder... and pick or create a folder on a drive with plenty of space.

blocks.text: If the folder you pick already contains a Djehuti storage container (a vfs.bin file), Station uses the projects and settings already in it.
The suite settings (the gear button in the header) show the current storage folder on the Storage tab.
Cancelling the folder chooser closes the application. There is no default folder.
